CustomField.description: FCRM-879 This field has been created to calculate the number of hours a case has spend unresolved.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND(RecordType.DeveloperName ='QAC_Contact_Us_Support',ISPICKVAL(Type,'NDC')), IF(IsClosed, FLOOR((ClosedDate - FreightLastCommDate__c)*24), FLOOR((NOW()-FreightLastCommDate__c)*24) ) , IF( ISBLANK( Reopened_Date__c ) , IF( ISBLANK( ClosedDate ) , ((Today() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24), ((DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24) ) , IF( ISBLANK( ClosedDate ) , ((Today() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24), ((DATEVALUE(ClosedDate) - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))*24) ) ) )
CustomField.label: Case Open Time (Hours)
